camel_example: aliyun aiworkspace GET /api/v1/workspaces/87000/configs --region cn-hangzhou --Verbose true --CategoryName CommonResourceConfig --Labels 'key1=value1,key2=value2' --ConfigKeys tempStoragePath --header "Content-Type=application/json"
description_en: Retrieves the list of workspace configurations
description_zh: 获取工作空间配置列表
kebab_example: aliyun aiworkspace list-configs --workspace-id 87000 --category-name CommonResourceConfig --config-keys tempStoragePath --labels key1=value1,key2=value2 --verbose true --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListConfigs

parameters.help_en:
The category of the configuration item. The following categories are supported:

CommonResourceConfig: common resource configuration.
DLCAutoRecycle: DLC automatic recycling.
DLCPriorityConfig: DLC priority settings.
DSWPriorityConfig: DSW priority settings.
QuotaMaximumDuration: maximum runtime duration configuration for DLC jobs in a quota.
CommonTagConfig: tag settings
parameters.help_zh:
配置项的分类。目前支持如下分类

CommonResourceConfig 通用资源配置
DLCAutoRecycle  DLC自动回收
DLCPriorityConfig DLC 优先级设置
DSWPriorityConfig DSW优先级设置
QuotaMaximumDuration Quota的DLC任务最大运行时长配置
CommonTagConfig 标签设置
parameters.name: category_name

parameters.help_en:
The keys of the configuration items. The following keys are supported:

tempStoragePath: the temporary storage path. This ConfigKey can be used only when CategoryName is set to CommonResourceConfig.
isAutoRecycle: the automatic recycling configuration. This ConfigKey can be used only when CategoryName is set to DLCAutoRecycle.
priorityConfig: the priority configuration. This ConfigKey can be used only when CategoryName is set to DLCPriorityConfig or DSWPriorityConfig.
quotaMaximumDuration: the maximum runtime duration configuration for DLC jobs in a quota. This ConfigKey can be used only when CategoryName is set to QuotaMaximumDuration.
predefinedTags: the preset tags for the workspace. Resources that are created must include these tags
parameters.help_zh:
配置项的键。目前支持如下键：

tempStoragePath 临时存储路径，只有CategoryName为CommonResourceConfig时才允许使用该ConfigKey
isAutoRecycle 自动回收配置，只有CategoryName为DLCAutoRecycle时才允许使用该ConfigKey
priorityConfig  优先级配置，只有CategoryName为DLCPriorityConfig或者DSWPriorityConfig时才允许使用该ConfigKey
quotaMaximumDuration Quota的DLC任务最大运行时长配置，只有CategoryName为QuotaMaximumDuration时才允许使用该ConfigKey
predefinedTags 工作空间预置标签，创建的资源必须带上标签
parameters.name: config_keys

parameters.help_en: The labels used as filter conditions. Separate multiple conditions with commas. These conditions are evaluated using a logical AND
parameters.help_zh: 标签作为过滤条件，多个条件用逗号分隔，这些条件之间是与的关系
parameters.name: labels

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to display label information. Valid values:

true: Display label information.
false: Do not display label information
parameters.help_zh:
是否展示Label信息

true：展示Label信息
false：不展示Label信息
parameters.name: verbose
